title: How Do You Handle Emotions? (EQ Check-in)
description: A quick check-in to understand your emotional intelligence. There are no right or wrong answers — just be honest about how you usually feel and behave.
wellbeing_disclaimer: This is a self-reflection activity, not a clinical test. There are no right or wrong answers. Answer honestly based on how you usually feel.

scoring_bands.message: Your emotional awareness is developing. Keep reflecting on how you feel and react in different situations.
You have a solid foundation of emotional intelligence. There are areas where you can grow further.
You show strong emotional intelligence across several areas. Keep building on your strengths!
You demonstrate excellent emotional awareness and management. You're well-equipped to handle complex social situations.

endings.title: Growing Your Emotional Skills
endings.message: Your emotional awareness is still developing — and that's perfectly okay! Everyone grows at their own pace. Try paying more attention to how you and others feel in everyday situations.

endings.title: Building a Strong Foundation
endings.message: You have a good foundation of emotional intelligence. You understand feelings reasonably well and handle many social situations with confidence. Keep practicing!

endings.title: Emotionally Aware
endings.message: You show strong emotional awareness! You're good at understanding your own feelings and connecting with others. This is a real strength.

endings.title: Exceptional Emotional Intelligence
endings.message: You demonstrate excellent emotional intelligence across all areas. You're highly attuned to your own emotions and those of others, and you manage social situations with great skill.

coaching_moment: Emotional intelligence is about understanding your own feelings, managing them well, recognizing emotions in others, and building strong relationships. Unlike IQ, EI can be developed throughout your life.
cultural_context: Emotional intelligence is increasingly recognized as critical for success in Indian schools and workplaces. This assessment helps students understand their EI profile across wellbeing, self-control, emotionality, and sociability.
reflection_prompt: What's one thing you'll take from this game into a real-world situation this week?
